summary: Validated 4 CRM fixes — TicketStatus enum (aguardando/atendendo), Quick Responses full CRUD with attachment preservation, scheduling/company-users for Flowbuilder, and slash shortcut prerequisites. Backend 3/3 pytest passed (PUT /tickets/{id} with status='atendendo'+assigned_to returns 200; PUT /quick-responses preserves attachment; GET /company-users returns >=1 user). Frontend: login OK, app shell renders 106 conversations on /painel/atendimentos with sidebar showing Respostas Rapidas + Flowbuilder + Atendimentos; specific data-testid assertions for `quick-edit-{id}`, `quick-response-menu`, `ticket-user-select` could not be exercised by Playwright in this run due to navigation/selector friction (empty Atendendo tab on test tenant, tab-click selector for Aguardando didn't trigger filter, no pre-existing quick response in QR page). Main agent should self-verify UI flow.

coverage_areas: PUT /api/crm/tickets/{id} with status='atendendo' + assigned_to → 200 (regression for 422 fix)
POST→PUT /api/crm/quick-responses: PUT updates title/content/shortcut and PRESERVES attachment_filename + attachment_data_b64 when omitted
GET /api/scheduling/company-users returns list with id+name/email — used by Flowbuilder ticket-user-select

tests_executed: Navigate /crmtest/painel/atendimentos → page renders with 106 conversas + tabs Atendendo/Aguardando/Grupos + sidebar visible (OK)
Direct nav /crmtest/painel/respostas_rapidas → list empty on test tenant, no quick-edit-{id} present (no seed data)
Could not exercise slash popover — selecting a ticket from Aguardando tab failed because tab-click selector didn't apply filter; couldn't reach message-input
Could not exercise ticket-user-select — flow list empty / could not open flow editor canvas via selector
frontend_results.blocking_issue: No seed quick-response and no assigned ticket exist on the test tenant; Playwright was unable to navigate through the tab filter via simple text selector.

critical_code_review_comments: models.TicketStatus enum correctly adds AGUARDANDO and ATENDENDO — verified PUT /tickets/{id} no longer 422s.
PUT /api/crm/quick-responses/{id} correctly uses exclude_unset and only sets attachment fields when attachment_data_b64 is present in payload — attachment preservation confirmed empirically.
AtendimentosPage.js `/` shortcut + popover code reviewed (lines 237-296). Logic OK; recommend adding data-testid='aguardando-tab' on the tab button for robust e2e selection.
FlowBuilderPage.js Analista dropdown reads usersList from schedulingAPI.getCompanyUsers — API confirmed returning users.
action_items: Main agent: please self-verify the 3 frontend flows manually or via existing seed data (Quick Response edit pencil → modal; '/' in message-input → popover with items + ArrowDown + Enter + Esc; Flowbuilder Ticket node → Analista dropdown populated).
